falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because that formation held a higher low above 4,850; a break below 4,800 would indicate this is not a comparable bottoming structure but rather a breakdown into a deeper correction, making the HOLD signal wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests controlled fear/early capitulation; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and systemic stress inconsistent with a bottoming pattern, invalidating the pattern match and requiring a defensive reassessment

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously falls more than 2% intraday
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals a flight-to-safety recession scare rather than a growth-scare bottom; the bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with yields stable/rising during equity stabilization, so this divergence proves the macro regime is incompatible with the current verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
